MuffinFixtureLatex: modified test-only Latin Modern Roman 10 v2.004

Original copyright: 2003, 2009 B. Jackowski and J. M. Nowacki, on behalf of
TeX users groups. Original license: GUST Font License, incorporating LPPL 1.3c
or later. See Latin-Modern-LICENSE.txt and LPPL-1.3c.txt in this directory.

These are modified, renamed ASCII subsets maintained by the Muffin project,
not by the original font authors. They retain the original copyright/license
metadata. Glyph outlines and advance tables are subset without redesign;
family/PostScript/CFF names are changed to MuffinFixtureLatex, and the delivery
format is WOFF2. They are test fixtures and are not application fonts.

Source directory (CTAN mirror):
https://mirrors.mit.edu/CTAN/fonts/lm/fonts/opentype/public/lm/

Reproduce with scripts/subset_text_fixture_fonts.py --latex <source-directory>;
that directory uses the short face names documented in README.md.
